summary: Added meterbill/money.py (exact integer-based rounding, no decimal context), routed all rounding/fixed-place formatting through it, removed the context line from __init__, added tests/test_money.py. Preserved quirks: batch (pool threads) kept half-even for band charges and effective price while bill/quote keep half-up; cash 'whole' still prints 0 (not -0); a non-string numeric cash step in a tariff book is not emulated bit-for-bit (28-digit context rounding).
